guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「光譜辨識、噴嘴時序與回收品質」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow spectral recognition, ejector timing and recovery quality through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「物料組成與目標」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 300 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以總進料作回收率分母會混同產率。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「單層送料與遮蔽」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.85 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「雙層物料可能讓光譜代表上件而噴嘴吹走下件。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「光譜訊噪比」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 20 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以訓練時乾燥樣本套用潮濕進料會產生域偏移。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「像素與物件尺寸」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1 mm/pixel，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報相機總像素不提供視野會無法判斷分辨力。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「分類精確率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「少量重污染物可能嚴重降低質量純度。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「召回率與漏失」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報純度可能掩蓋大量目標流入殘渣。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「輸送帶與噴嘴延遲」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.35 s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「固定延遲遇到變速會噴錯位置。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「噴嘴解析與氣耗」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.06 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「脈寬過長會提高誤帶和壓縮空氣需求。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「質量收支與抽樣」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.99 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「不具代表性樣品會高估全批純度。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「模型漂移與人工複核」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.05 fraction points，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用同批訓練樣本報性能會高估泛化。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for feed composition and target, first reproduce 300 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using total feed as recovery denominator confuses yield." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for monolayer feeding and occlusion, first reproduce 0.85 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Two layers can make spectra identify the upper object while the jet moves another." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for spectral signal-to-noise ratio, first reproduce 20 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A dry training set can fail on wet feed through domain shift." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pixels and object size, first reproduce 1 mm/pixel, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Pixel count without field of view does not establish resolution." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for classification precision, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A few heavy contaminants can strongly reduce mass purity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for recall and missed recovery, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Purity alone can hide target loss to residue." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for belt travel and ejector delay, first reproduce 0.35 s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Fixed delay during speed changes ejects the wrong position." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for jet resolution and air use, first reproduce 0.06 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "An overly long pulse increases entrainment and air demand." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for mass balance and sampling, first reproduce 0.99 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unrepresentative samples overstate batch purity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for model drift and human review, first reproduce 0.05 fraction points, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reporting training-set performance overstates generalization." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 把進料中PET比例改變，觀察分母。
固定相機設定，改變送料厚度比較漏檢。
量測乾淨和髒污樣本的光譜差異。
把視野加倍但像素數不變，檢查小物件。
加入大質量誤判物，比較計數精確率與質量純度。
繪出三個分類閾值的精確率與召回率。
帶速增加10%，同步調整觸發時間。
比較單噴嘴與相鄰噴嘴同觸發的夾帶。
在不同時段抽樣，不只抓最乾淨一把產品。
用新包材建立保留測試集並比較版本。
evidenceEn: Vary feed PET fraction and track denominators.
Keep camera settings and vary bed depth to compare misses.
Compare spectra of clean and dirty samples.
Double field of view at fixed pixels and inspect small objects.
Add a heavy false positive and compare count precision with mass purity.
Plot precision and recall for three thresholds.
Increase belt speed ten percent and update trigger timing.
Compare entrainment from one versus adjacent jets.
Sample multiple times rather than the cleanest handful.
Create a held-out new-packaging set and compare versions.
pitfalls: 以總進料作回收率分母會混同產率。
雙層物料可能讓光譜代表上件而噴嘴吹走下件。
以訓練時乾燥樣本套用潮濕進料會產生域偏移。
只報相機總像素不提供視野會無法判斷分辨力。
少量重污染物可能嚴重降低質量純度。
只報純度可能掩蓋大量目標流入殘渣。
固定延遲遇到變速會噴錯位置。
脈寬過長會提高誤帶和壓縮空氣需求。
不具代表性樣品會高估全批純度。
用同批訓練樣本報性能會高估泛化。
pitfallsEn: Using total feed as recovery denominator confuses yield.
Two layers can make spectra identify the upper object while the jet moves another.
A dry training set can fail on wet feed through domain shift.
Pixel count without field of view does not establish resolution.
A few heavy contaminants can strongly reduce mass purity.
Purity alone can hide target loss to residue.
Fixed delay during speed changes ejects the wrong position.
An overly long pulse increases entrainment and air demand.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 垃圾自動真空收集
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
